heroHeadline: Day 703: Security Cabinet Details Ojocaliente Car Bomb (200kg Explosives, 3 Detained) as Sheinbaum Opens State Tour From Zacatecas
heroSubtitle: September 4, 2026 marks Day 703 of Claudia Sheinbaum's presidency. Holding her mañanera in Zacatecas — the first stop of a state-by-state tour following her Second Government Report — Sheinbaum's Security Cabinet detailed findings on the August 30 Ojocaliente car bomb attack: Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch said the device used roughly 200 kilograms of explosives, confirmed three detentions, and cited a CJNG-Cartel del Pacífico route dispute as a leading investigative line, while also confirming an active U.S. extradition order against CJNG leader Juan Carlos Valencia González, who holds dual Mexican-American nationality. Harfuch cited a 96% drop in Zacatecas's daily homicide average since 2021 and 60,000 arrests nationally for high-impact crimes since October 2024. That followed a September 3 mañanera in which Sheinbaum confirmed her dual-nationality candidacy ban and General Femicide Law had been formally sent to Congress, and previewed a 2027 Economic Package built around fuel-tax traceability and "gradual" fiscal consolidation (deficit targets of 4.1% of GDP for 2026 and 3.5% for 2027) ahead of its September 8 submission. Those developments build on the September 1 Second Government Report and the September 2 mañanera redesign.
